title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 03 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. 80 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 20, GA 20, Maths 20, English 20.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC GD Constable latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Needle : Sew :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: Needle is used to sew; knife is used to cut.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 10, 29, 66, 127, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P->Q, E->F, N->O, C->D, I->J, L->M so QFODJM.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man says, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father; his daughter is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person walks 8 km East, then 6 km North. Distance from starting point is:
questions.explanation: Right triangle: sqrt(8^2+6^2)=sqrt(64+36)=10 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256, 288
questions.explanation: Others are perfect squares (11^2 to 16^2); 288 is not a perfect square.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are tables. Conclusions: I. Some pens are tables. II. All tables are books.
questions.explanation: Some books are tables does not force pens to be tables; II is also not certain.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents: Doctors, Males, Engineers?
questions.explanation: A person can be male doctor, male engineer, or all three; categories overlap.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find next: ACE, BDF, CEG, DFH, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter of previous +1: D+1=E, F+1=G, H+1=I so EGI.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2023 was Tuesday, what day was 15 August 2024?
questions.explanation: 2024 is leap year and 15 Aug is after Feb 29, so +2 days: Tuesday -> Thursday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock together?
questions.explanation: Together at (30H)/5.5 min past H = 90/5.5 = 180/11 = 16 4/11 min past 3.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a clock shows 3:20, the mirror image time is approximately:
questions.explanation: Mirror time = 11:60 minus given time = 11:60-3:20 = 8:40.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal and a hole is punched near the fold. How many holes after unfolding?
questions.explanation: One fold along diagonal creates 2 layers; one punch gives 2 holes on unfolding.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 11th from left and B is 9th from right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: Position of B from left = 40-9+1=32. Between A(11) and B(32): 32-11-1=20.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All flowers are beautiful. Some beautiful things are rare. Conclusion: Some flowers are rare.
questions.explanation: Some beautiful things being rare does not imply that flowers are among those rare things.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following cannot be formed using letters of the word 'CONSTABLE'?
questions.explanation: STABLES needs two S; CONSTABLE has only one S.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means ×, × means −, − means ÷ and ÷ means +, then value of 6 + 3 × 4 − 2 ÷ 5 is:

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. A is left of B but right of C. D is right of B. E is between B and D. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order C-A-B-E-D. Middle is B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A cube is painted on all faces and cut into 27 small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: 3×3×3 cube: edge cubes excluding corners = 12 have exactly 2 faces painted.
